responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/impl_wf_check/min_specialization.rs: Implements the `min_specialization` soundness checks for specializing impls and always-applicable specialization traits. It finds the parent specialization node, compares the specializing impl against its base trait or impl, and validates the restrictions that make the specialization always applicable: required item/constness compatibility, absence of disallowed `'static` use, duplicate use of unconstrained generic parameters, and that added predicates are either inherited, implied by well-formedness/supertraits, or permitted specialization markers. It emits the diagnostics for unsupported specialization predicates and other minimal-specialization violations.
